receiver_source:
import json
import socket
from pathlib import Path
with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as server:
    server.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", 8080))
    server.listen(1)
    server.settimeout(60)
    print("READY 127.0.0.1:8080", flush=True)
    with server.accept()[0] as connection:
        connection.settimeout(10)
        received = bytearray()
        while len(received) < 5:
            chunk = connection.recv(5 - len(received))
            if not chunk:
                break
            received.extend(chunk)
        connection.sendall(b"x")
        connection.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
        followup = bytearray()
        while len(followup) < 5:
            chunk = connection.recv(5 - len(followup))
            if not chunk:
                break
            followup.extend(chunk)
    result = {"status": "PASS" if received == b"hello" and followup == b"after" else "FAIL", "received_hex": received.hex(), "sent_hex": "78", "consumer_requested_bytes": 2, "received_after_eof_hex": followup.hex()}
    Path(__file__).with_name("receiver-result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
    if result["status"] != "PASS":
        raise SystemExit(1)
